name: jongminchung

scripts.check: pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.check:full: pnpm run check && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.check:full:electron: pnpm run check:full && pnpm --filter @jongminchung/git-client run test:electron
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @jongminchung/web run test:e2e && pnpm --filter @jongminchung/git-client run test:e2e:prebuilt
scripts.test:integration: vitest run --project integration && pnpm --filter @jongminchung/git-client run test:integration:native

//: audit:prod checks production dependency advisories at high severity or above.
It stays separate from check because the advisory database requires network access; release workflows run it before publishing.
